name: AI-Generated Integration Security and Governance Obligation-Gap Benchmark
description: Reproducibility package for the study Benchmarking Security and Governance Obligation Gaps in AI-Generated Integration Code for Public-Service APIs. Version 1.1.0 adds the calibrated pre-ranked functional harness, a 245-program adversarial calibration suite, 210 representation-diverse structural positive controls, task-semantic applicability analysis, prespecified causal controls, and a 600-program three-seed robustness wave. The archive contains benchmark code, task definitions, generated programs and raw responses, analysis outputs, and reproduction instructions; manuscript files are excluded.
